findings: The 'naked sine waves' are real and are a DRIVER BUG, not a preset choice: produceReplay.mts replayed the r2 program's trackIds verbatim (`// swap: track/clip ids are assumed stable`). Round 3's preflight inserted a highpass per synth track, so every later track id shifted by one (r2: lead 1020, chords 1025, drone 1030, counter 1035, arp 1040, ambient 1045, stab 1050; r3: 1020, 1026, 1032, 1038, 1044, 1050, 1056).

MoshOps add_midi_clip auto-creates a track for an unknown trackId and gives it the default 4OSC (DRM-001). Result in BOTH r3 renders: chords/drone/counter/arp/ambient notes played on auto-created 'Track 10–14' through a bare oscillator at 0 dB, no highpass, no gain map; the Ambient Pad track (1050) played the STAB notes; the real Chords/Drone/Counter/Arp/Stab Vital tracks were silent (not even exported as stems).
Stem evidence: Track 10–14 spectral flatness 1e-10 to 1e-9 (pure tones) at −12.5 to −23 dB RMS vs the r2 Vital stems at 1e-5 to 3e-3; only the Lead and Ambient Pad stems carried preset names.

So the verdict judged: kit-matched/labkit drums + 808 through the new master chain, the Lead preset, and five sine-wave parts. 'Sounds better' (drums/808/master) stands; the preset judgment does not apply to the curated presets — they were never heard in round 3.
Round-2's labkit twin was NOT affected (same preflight as its original run, ids matched). The pass on B-labkit-r2-opus-s3 stands.

Fix: replay remaps program trackIds by ROLE via the original run's template.json (ui/src/agent/loop/produceReplayRemap.ts, tested), refuses unmappable ids, and fails loudly if the track count grows during the note replay. Renders re-issued as r3b-opus-s3-{kitmatched,labkit}.

SECOND round-3 bug, found while verifying the r3b re-render: the `highpass` builtin's live Frequency parameter probed at 0.1814 normalised = Tracktion's 4000 Hz default. The preflight's 180 Hz was written to the CachedValue only; te::LowPassPlugin::updateFilters() reads the AutomatableParameter. So every melodic track in r3/r3b was highpassed at 4 kHz (drone stem centroid 229 → 3600 Hz; chords stem −22 → −60 dB RMS; lead >4 kHz energy 3 % → 44 %). 'Too boring / thin' was partly this. Fixed in MoshOps load_builtin/load_master_builtin (frequency->setParameter) with the selftest now reading the parameter; renders re-issued as r3c.
